## Type

## Quality checklist (required)

- [ ] **Estimates** show their assumptions step by step and are labeled as estimates.
- [ ] **Provenance**: prompts and follow-ups are marked Representative unless a public source is linked.
- [ ] **Links**: every external link resolves and points to a paper, official doc, engineering blog or known repo.
- [ ] **Mermaid**: the diagram renders on GitHub (labels with punctuation are quoted).
- [ ] **Template**: a new design follows the section order in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] **License**: adapted text or code is from MIT, Apache-2.0 or CC0 and attributed.
- [ ] Internal links are relative and resolve.
